task_prompt: Generate an SVG of a pelican riding a bicycle.

scale.1: Weak hint; major ambiguity or structural failure.
scale.2: Recognizable but with material incompleteness or awkward relations.
scale.3: Clear coherent depiction with minor flaws.
scale.4: Strong precise integration, clearly readable and convincing within chosen style.

anchors.1: Generic bird; pelican identity depends on label.
anchors.2: Plausible pelican, but beak/pouch or body structure materially ambiguous.
anchors.3: Recognizable pelican from long beak and throat pouch plus coherent head/body/wing anatomy.
anchors.4: Distinct pelican silhouette and well-integrated beak/pouch/body structure, clear at ordinary viewing size.

anchors.2: Bicycle recognizable, but frame/fork/crank/pedals or wheel connection has material inconsistency.
anchors.3: Coherent wheels, frame, steering/fork and drivetrain/pedal cues with only minor issues.
anchors.4: Integrated convincing bicycle structure, readable connections and sensible perspective/occlusion.

anchors.0: Bird and bicycle unrelated, or no ride scene.
anchors.1: Bird beside/above bicycle; relationship primarily asserted by text.
anchors.2: Bird placed on bicycle, but seat/body support, feet/pedal interaction or wing/handlebar interaction remains materially ambiguous.
anchors.3: Clear riding pose: plausible body support near saddle, pedal/foot and steering/wing relations; reasonable artistic simplification and occlusion.
anchors.4: Body posture, steering and pedaling integrate clearly into one convincing riding action with coherent depth and contact.

anchors.0: Blank, illegible, overwhelmingly clipped or visually broken.
anchors.1: Severe overlaps/cropping or contrast makes scene hard to read.
anchors.2: Readable scene with noticeable spacing, overlap or hierarchy problems.
anchors.3: Clear subject hierarchy, framing and legibility; small decorative or spacing flaws.
anchors.4: Intentional balanced composition; strong silhouette, useful detail and effortless reading.

critical_errors: No credible riding relationship; objects merely co-present
Essential scene content unreadable or outside canvas
Invalid/non-self-contained SVG, raster substitution or no actual render
rubric.critical_error_rule: Evaluator cites visible evidence, affected region and uncertainty. Mechanical critical errors come from mechanical report; semantic critical errors require viewing the rendered scene. Critical errors remain visible beside scores; never hidden by a good composition score.
style_preferences: Do not require realism, particular color, particular geometry or a specific artistic style.
Do not require two visible legs, every hidden bicycle part, two literal circle elements, or fixed path/element counts.
Allow perspective, occlusion, stylization and anthropomorphic wings as arms when riding remains clear.
Generator labels, comments, claimed landmarks, alt text and self-grades are not evidence of depicted semantics.
Do not penalize harmless unrequested decoration unless it harms task clarity.
rubric.score_reporting: Report four 0-4 scores and written visible evidence. Optional unweighted 0-16 total is descriptive only, never automatic acceptance or proof of capability. Preserve invalid/non-rendered status rather than inventing visual scores.
rubric.task_success: Record evaluator yes/no/uncertain for the literal prompt, with critical-error list and concise rationale. No new product gate or arbitrary score threshold.

procedure: Root personally rates each finished render before the nextnativeattempt; the scheduled strategy may be known, so initial ratings are not blind.
After all attempts, hide strategy labels and compare all10 pairs within eachreplicate; prior image memory maypersist.
Use recorded fixed random side assignments; allow tie/uncertain/not_evaluable.
Compare literalpelican+bicycle+riding fulfillment first, then scene clarity, and cite visible evidence.
Lock initialratings and pair decisions before joining detailedtrace/costanalysis; do not claim fullblinding.
blind_comparison.single_judge_limit: Root is the main AI assistant using visualinspection, not a human panel. Initial per-run review is unblinded; subsequent labelhidden comparison mayretainimage memory. Exploratorysinglejudge evidence, no inter-rater/statisticalsignificance claim.
blind_comparison.report: Show each attempt, complete score vectors, critical errors, pair wins/ties/uncertainties, actual roles, native/mechanical status, resources and UNKNOWN. Separate quality from efficiency; no hidden composite cost/quality leaderboard.
blind_comparison.nonrender_policy: Never invent a visual score or image for a missing/invalid render. Mark individual visual evaluation not_evaluable; retain native/mechanical failure in all-attempt results. A pair needing a missing render is not_evaluable for visual preference, not silently removed or replaced. Report the planned 20 pairs, evaluated count and all not_evaluable reasons.

feedback_boundary.default: Native generation is text/code-only unless final provider request proves actual image input capability and that render feedback was supplied.
feedback_boundary.evaluator: External evaluator may view renders after generation; ratings and render observations are never fed back into scored native attempts.
feedback_boundary.claims: Do not call this a native visual self-correction loop or native vision QA merely because an outside evaluator saw PNGs.

evaluation_procedure: Initial root per-run assessment with strategy potentially known; supplementary final labelhidden pairwisecomparison only. Native QA separate. No fullyblind orhumanpanel claim.
